Clemenceau, there's something massive over there!
Is it... a black tower?
Tower...
Damn it all. We're suspending the operation. Withdraw at once!

sequence: Skies above the Holy Unitas Empire

scripts.say: Marco Polo's presence in Hierophant's test sites is, in a word, reassuring.
All it took was her activating a few devices to make Tribunal's Hand-ready airstrips materialize out of thin air along the divine waterways.
This allows us to use the Tribunal's Hand's aircraft configuration to the fullest.
Upon our decision to execute the Worldlinking Ritual, Marco Polo selected Florence, a city at the very edge of the Apennine Peninsula, as the venue.
However, when the Tribunal's Hand reached the skies above Genoa, there was a sudden change in the netherworld lying just outside of the Imperial barrier.
Commander, a massive cylindrical structure has appeared within the netherworld. It's stretching upward!
Transmitting visual feed!
Live footage of the scene is displayed on the screen in front of my seat.
Not that I need it – the colossal object visibly rises outside the window.
I gaze fixedly at the ever-growing cylinder through the Tribunal's Hand's shields and the Holy Unitas Empire's barriers.
A black spire piercing the heavens...
No – it looks black at first glance, but it really comprises countless colorful patterns.
The patterns shift and undulate. For some reason, the phrase "charging pile" comes to mind.
Commander, we have word from Götz... She says an enormous object is rising from the netherworld's depths.
I presume that's the same thing we're looking at...
Oh, this is really bad... This signals the transition to the next phase. Things are taking a turn for the worse!
Commander, ask Götz if any of her people are still in the water!
If they are, they must not surface – tell them that they are to wait for me beneath the surface!
Underwater? Why?
We can't go by the book anymore. I'll have to do the ritual here and now!
What a shame... I was all excited to use Eugen and Z2 to the fullest, but it's up to me now!
Hurry and open the hatch. I'm going to jump! I need to take the shortest route into the netherworld, meet up with U-2501, and complete the ritual!
Surely you remember the last time you fell from the sky...
Enough babbling about the past! Today, raw bravado prevails!
Just you wait – I'll be back with good tidings before long!
Goodbye!
After receiving the urgent report, U-2501 stayed alone amidst the darkness, never surfacing.
Eventually, she felt a warm light.
Light? Down here?
Heeey! Can you hear me?
Along with the light appeared a faint figure.
You're... Marco Polo, the Apostle, aren't you?
Why are you transparent?
Because I've become light to complete the ritual with you, of course!
Complete the ritual...?
That's right – I need an assistant for this ritual. Somebody has to drive down the conceptual anchor, after all!
You're already underwater, see? Good luck!
What's a... conceptual anchor? Where is it?
It's this very light. Now open those eyes and ears, alright?
In an instant, an anchor and chain seemed to appear amidst the light, followed by the resounding of heavy metal.
This light is the anchor. Follow it down and guide it to the deepest depths!
The fate of the world hangs in the balance. Can you do this?
All I have to do is keep going down, right?
Okay... Leave it to me.
Alone, U-2501 descended deeper and deeper. Her current depth far exceeded any record she'd set before.
The light continued to cast away the darkness, but formless terror gradually tightened its grip on her heart.

sequence: "How much deeper do you have to go?"
"This is all a trap! A conspiracy, a betrayal!"

scripts.say: Bad thoughts...
Tricks of the netherworld...
It won't shake my resolve...
Had it been an hour? A day? A week?
Perhaps a month, a year, or even hundreds of years?
Time itself seemed to blur. Beyond that thin veil of light, the abyss exerted ever-growing pressure.
The veil seemed so fragile, as if it could collapse at any moment and usher in death.

sequence: "It's all over already. What are you trying so hard for?"

scripts.say: The bad thoughts... are getting desperate...
When I chose to do deep-dives... it was to understand and defeat you.
Finally... I have my chance.
You've taken too many of my friends away... and I won't let you have another.
I'll persevere to the very end...
Until the light has driven off all the darkness...
Until victory is ours!
A second ray of light shot forth.
This time, it came from deep in the depths.
It gradually spread, creating one dividing line between the surface and the depths.
Atop this new surface stood a world brimming with light.
A new world...
A world belonging to the Sardegnia League.

sequence: Skies above the Holy Unitas Empire

scripts.say: Marco Polo's actions were swift and decisive.
Only five minutes after she'd leapt out of the cabin, the world began to change.
Blinding light surged from the netherworld, creating a faint outline of the Apennine Peninsula.
The ritual seems to be going well...
I gaze at the light in the distance.
However, before I realize it, I'm engulfed as well.
Amidst the boundless white, I make out three indistinct figures.
Hierophant, Devil... Who's the third one?
What are they talking about?
Hierophant must be trying to tell me something... Why can't I understand any of it?
Are you speaking to me?
Who are you? What is it you're trying to say?
I try to scrutinize the figure before me, but suddenly, there's a booming roar.
It came from a bundle of light floating in midair.
Radiance more dazzling than the sun overloaded my five senses, as if to prevent me from learning anything more.
The world shatters. I realize that I'm in the Tribunal's Hand again.
Ever-intensifying light radiates from the peninsula, but no matter how I observe it, I can't get that mysterious vision to come back.
Something is trying to stop me from gathering intel.
What was it, though? Could it be related to Hierophant's anxiety?
It was an ordinary, uneventful day. The sun set yesterday as usual, then rose again in the morning as usual.
Today was another hope-filled day, because...
The fresco I've been working on for the cathedral's ceiling is finally done!
Once the final product is delivered and I receive my due payment, it's time to enjoy the high life and bask in luxury for a good while~♪
Hum hum~ Lalalaaah~♪
I could hear you humming from all the way over there. So, are you all done with the fresco?
Esattamente! Come and see for yourself! It's my masterpiece of the month!
"The Sacrament's Triumphal Return"... Indeed, I understand the theme of your art well.
But I must say, the scenery is about... strange? What is this pole supposed to be? Some sort of lamppost?
It is called a "streetlight"! A revelation shown to me in a dream by Her Holiness, the Apostle!
It came to you in a dream, huh... How nice.
If only Her Holiness could visit me in my dreams as well and leave me with words of inspiration for my poetry...
Raffaello and Giosuè left the cathedral, chatting as they walked.
Gradually, the two of them could make out a growing chorus of surprised voices.
...What's all this commotion by the side of the road? Did the circus come by?
No, they seem to be mentioning something about the sky...
...The sky, huh? Come on, I'll take you to the top of the tower! It'll be the best vantage point!
Raffaelo and Giosuè climbed to the highest tower in the cathedral complex.
The sun still hung high in the sky, but it was shrouded in a thick, turbid darkness.
Light and dark were cleanly separated, as if the sky itself was a canvas.
There, in the boundary between black and white, floated a colossal throne.
Though the silhouette of the figure sitting atop the throne was hard to identify, her voice was unmistakable as it boomed out across all of the Sardegnia League.
Sardegna Ecclesia–– Republic of Florence–– Republic of Genoa––
Dukedom of Milan–– Republic of Venice–– Kingdom of Naples–– Kingdom of Sicily––
Your Apostle... has returned!
Marco Polo succeeded.
She shocked everyone by performing a "miracle" in an attention-commanding way only she could pull off.
In this test site, nobody would ever doubt her status as the Apostle again.
With the Worldlinking Ritual complete and the preconditions for the Emperor Summoning Ritual met as well, it was time to move on to the next phase–
The long days of travel were starting to take a toll on everyone. Except for Marco Polo, that is.
She remained in high spirits. Even as the night deepened, she continued to meticulously go over every preparation for tomorrow's ritual.
Though in her enthusiasm, she also happened to rope in everyone nearby.
Darn that Marco Polo!
Commander, we can handle things over here. Do you want to go rest?
I'm also concerned about how her preparations are going... Wouldn't be able to sleep well with that hanging over my head anyway.
Your Holiness, all the electors will be present to recite the prayer at tomorrow's ceremony.
After that, the ritual will commence.
About that. Let's put in some security measures.
Just in case, I want everyone to leave after the prayer is finished, whether they are human or shipgirl.
It shall be done. Did you have any problems with the content of the prayer?
Nothing major. Just take this part out.
Let me see... Are you referring to this mention of the "Hohenstaufer Dynasty"?
Yep. Overly specific descriptions are never a good thing when it comes to summoning rituals.
Understood. Do you have any other issues with the prayer?
Nah, I'm good for now. Though, maybe I'll do one final pass before I can rest and prepare for the big day!
Right now? I don't think you'll have much time to rest if you do another pass...
The next day...
In accordance with the agreed-upon protocols, everyone else left the building after the recitation of the prayer. The only people left in the great hall were Marco Polo and myself.
If everyone else is leaving, doesn't that mean I should go as well?
Eh, it's fine. You're not like the rest of them. You're a true "veteran" at this point, right~♪
You already carried out the ritual that summoned me here, right? This one's just going to be more of the same.
Besides, your presence adds another "wedge" that might just save us some trouble...
..."Wedge"?
You'll understand soon enough. Now then, witness how your Apostle performs her works!
Marco Polo's expression suddenly becomes serious, and her entire demeanor changes.
As words of praise flow from her lips, her entire body begins to radiate light.
Soon, the entire hall is engulfed in her blinding aura.
Amidst the infinite expanse of pure white, a human figure takes shape.
You're... the person I saw in the illusion previously? Who are you? An Arbiter?
<I am known as Arbiter: The Emperor IV>
<Upon the name of the Emperor, I have come to respond to your summons.>
<"It" has come to obstruct me. As such, I have been confronting "It".>
<Time is running short.>
<Transboundary Experiment #1... must be completed at all costs.>
Before I can even ask a single question, the figure vanishes into the light.

As my sight begins to adjust, I can tell that I am still in the great hall, with Marco Polo continuing to chant beside me. The overwhelming light has started to coalesce into the shape of a person atop the throne.
A person who I knew well, though only in the recesses of my memories – Friedrich der Große.
This test site... the great hall of the Imperial Palace... the Imperator of the Holy Unitas Empire...
Never could I have imagined that this title would belong to me.
Despite being a comprehensively misused concept, it has become reality due to the wedge driven into it.
How interesting.
What do you mean by... misused concept?
It would appear that Marco Polo has misled and manipulated you for her own personal gain, my child.
Ahaha...
But I will leave it at that, seeing as how the end result was acceptable.
Heh heh. I knew you of all people would understand my intentions.
So... are you really Friedrich der Große? The same person I knew from test site beta, who went to join the Ashes?
...Or are you the Friedrich der Große from another test site? Or something even more conceptual than that?
I see you've already begun to grasp the fundamental principles behind the blueprint ships, my child.
Though, now is not the time to answer such a question.
You needed me, and I responded to that need. That is all you need to know for now.
Now then, all that remains is the coronation. Let us resolve this crisis, hand in hand.
Finally, the coronation! I've been waiting for this for ages!
Friedrich der Große sits upright in her throne, and Marco Polo carries the crown over with solemnity and places it upon Friedrich's head.
Countless beams of light, guided by the crown, shoot high into the sky before raining down across every inch of the empire's land.
In an instant, the atmosphere that has dominated the Holy Unitas Empire transforms into something altogether different.
Doubt and anxiety melt away and give rise to a renewed sense of hope and determination.
The Apostle has crowned the Emperor. The coronation ceremony for the Holy Unitas Empire has finally been completed.

sequence: Great Hall of the Imperial Palace

scripts.say: After the ceremony, Friedrich der Große received the blessings of her audience, as was customary.
But, bad news quickly came to dampen the mood of this momentous occasion.
Following the coronation, the netherworld launched a full-scale assault. Combat reports are flooding in from all border regions.
The enemy's combat capabilities have improved as well...
(Sending enemies perfectly tuned to our combat capabilities – another common feature of Siren test sites.)
(We'll need reinforcements for all the Empire's defensive lines.)
(Now that Friedrich der Große is the Emperor, resource allocation shouldn't be an issue anymore.)
(With Marco Polo overseeing maintenance, the waterways shouldn't be a concern, either.)
(We'd best make use of the transport drones stationed at each airfield, too.)
My child? My child, are you listening?
Her voice interrupts my train of thought.
I'm right here.
As I'm sure you recall, I was summoned to lead the Holy Unitas Empire and stabilize the situation.
But why were you brought here, my child?
How will you destroy the netherworld? How will you bring this experiment to its end?
What does Transcender truly mean? What is Hierophant trying to achieve?
These are the matters you must focus on, my child.

options.content: You're right. I'll leave this in your hands.
Where do you think I should start?

scripts.say: The most suspicious target would be the five towers that suddenly appeared. I'll start by investigating them.
Do not worry yourself with the war. Peruse as you please.
The five towers, surely.
Rising from the earth to pierce the heavens – they're the most apt match we have to the concept of ascension.
By the way, may I borrow Prinz Eugen and Marco Polo for a spell?
Are you sending them to the front lines?
That is the plan.
Huh?
Be my guest.
Wait a second!
Marco Polo, you'll be deployed to the Sardegnia League.
I retract my complaints. I'll head there at once!
The Sardegnia League is assigned to the southern and eastern fronts, while keeping watch over the towers positioned there.
Prinz Eugen, you are to proceed to the Imperial border, support Königsberg, and watch the tower there.
Köln, you and Mainz will lead the Hagiobull Alliance's main forces, protecting the defensive line from the northern coast to the Iris border while monitoring the remaining two towers.
The rest of our forces along the five battle lines will remain in place. You four will have the authority to command them.
As you wish.
(Five towers, five battle lines... Hierophant is the fifth Arbiter. Does the number five have a secret meaning?)
(I've never been one for solving riddles, especially when I have a war to focus on.)
(Take a deep breath... Calm down.)
(Marco Polo aside, Clemenceau surely has the best understanding of this system.)
(I wouldn't be surprised if Clemenceau knows even more than her.)
(On that note, the Iris Orthodoxy's documents may not be her true objective.)
(She may have realized something already. That would explain why she wanted to split up.)
What will you do, my child? Where will you begin?
The tower located in the Iris Orthodoxy.
Heehee. I was just about to recommend the same.
Let us play a beautiful melody together.
KABOOOOM!
Along the border, the Imperial barrier marks a stark divide.
Light swirls around each combatant, infusing every strike with the power to banish sin.
Divine light has forced the abyss to bare its fangs.
This is the darkest hour before dawn, the final struggle of the dying...
Beautiful, bloody, frenzied. I can't take my eyes off of it.
It's too soon to say that the enemy is dying, Königsberg.
At best... you might call them a wounded animal, perhaps?
Do you mean to say that their frenzied offensive has only just begun?
We must bleed the enemy more. The more violently they struggle, the closer death comes to them.
Assuming we aren't the first to bleed out, of course.
Heheheh. As reinforcements dispatched by Her Majesty herself, we have high hopes for you all.
Your compliments are appreciated.
Z2, let's give it 300% this time.
I'll do my best, but I really wish I'd said no...
KABOOOOM!
After being briefed on the situation, the experienced fighters of the Sardegnia League organized a swift counterattack against the netherworld forces.
The power of conceptual symbols has been amplified here, but the negative effects of METAmorphosis have vanished.
It's the perfect place to fight to our hearts' content.
KABOOOOM!
A magnificent throne soared through the sky. Even amidst her fight for aerial supremacy, Marco Polo directed the battle beneath her.
Maintain a steady formation and keep your shields braced firmly behind the barrier!
Your muskets are firing too low! Aim five degrees higher to match the trajectory of the tracer rounds!
Double line formation! DOUBLE, now!
What do you mean to accomplish in a single line? Who on earth is in charge of this fleet?!
Your formation's been broken! Don't tell me you expect to get through their blockade in such a mess!
Aircraft carriers, send your planes after me! I will personally lead the charge!
Well... She's a unique Apostle, I'll give her that.
Unique is a good word. But she led us to a legendary victory not long ago, so she's earned my trust and respect!
Morale is soaring... [I'm getting fired up, too >w<]
Shall we join the battle once deployments are complete?
Wait! Her Holiness has just sent us an urgent transmission!
It says... look up...?
Up? Oh... Something that looks like a scroll of parchment is falling down!
Let's see here...
What does it say?!
Her Holiness's scroll says...
Deploy the Lattice of God's Light!
Once my objective was clear, I took the Tribunal's Hand to Reims's defensive line.
While this Iris-held territory is positioned outside of the Imperial barrier, Clemenceau's leadership has already stabilized the war situation.
I've finally figured out your goal. You came here to inspect something other than the Orthodoxy's documents, didn't you?
Congratulations, Commander. Do you feel you've developed a more intimate understanding of me?
Did you find the answer you were looking for?
As soon as I discovered a hint, the clues practically offered themselves up to me.
As for you, Transcender... You plan to use the tower to grasp the meaning of that title, I presume?
That's what I'm hoping for. During the ritual, I saw a vision.
We may have been mistaken from the very start.
If I'm right, then the Transcender ritual isn't a way to summon a specific person – it's a means of activating a Transboundary Experiment.
As for the word itself, I think it may refer to something else instead of me – or a specific act, perhaps...
For example... If one ascended that tower, would they become a Transcender?
Ascending a stairway to the heavens, hmm?
It's a reasonable reading, granted, but it feels far too simple.
Moreover, these black towers are hardly ascendable by any mere human.
It's the only clue I have, at any rate. I'll just have to try.
Ugh... I can lead battles against enemy fleets all day, but riddles are not my strong suit.
Have you considered the possibility of a shortcut?
Commander, are you implying that you learned about a Transboundary Experiment through a vision?
Who told you about it?
It was an Arbiter who called herself... The Emperor.
She was confronting something that she just called "It," so that I can help Hierophant complete this experiment.
Are the Emperor and Hierophant the only two in charge of this Transboundary Experiment?
Previous ones involved the cooperation of multiple Arbiters, did they not?
Devil is here, too. Maybe the number of personnel required depends on which stage the experiment is in?
Devil, Hierophant, and Emperor...
Does a specific condition trigger these visions?
I think so, but I don't have the faintest idea what it might be.
Hierophant's vision was during the Worldlinking Ritual, while Emperor's was during the Emperor Summoning Ritual.
So in short, Hierophant still cannot communicate directly, while Emperor is busy confronting something.
Why not try talking with Devil, then?
Devil... That could work.
Wait. Is your shortcut just directly asking Devil to ask her for the answer directly?
Precisely. Find a symbol associated with demons, and try performing a ritual in accordance with this world's logic.
The Sin Shadows would be an easy choice. They disappear when defeated, though. I wonder if there's a way to capture one...
I question whether those monsters truly are the manifestation of the concept of demons, but I happen to have something more suitable.
How about this?
Clemenceau holds up one hand, causing several pieces of black scrap metal to fall onto the ground.
What the... You have wreckage from Devil's planes?!
But Arbiters always clean up their wreckage after combat. How did you get your hands on that?
I recovered it from the Kingdom of God. It's unclear why she couldn't immediately retrieve it, but that was a stroke of fortune for me.
She was pretty "occupied" with the Tower at the time...
But yes, that is a stroke of fortune. What gave you the idea to take it with you?
I carry all sorts of odds and ends around.
Such as...?
Nothing that I'll share with you.
I thought you'd say that.
Heehee. I'd best prepare for the ritual now.
If you'd please minimize any potential distractions – be they enemies or the netherworld itself – that would be much appreciated.
I'm sure I can trust you with that.
You want me to lead a fleet? Finally, I can do something I'm good at.
Focus on your preparations. I'll handle the rest.
KABOOOOM!
The enemy may be stronger, but they still hardly qualify as an obstacle.
Before long, we've managed to clear an ample safe zone.
That will suffice, Commander.
I will now use the Black Sun to draw you into the ritual.
I receive a sudden message from Clemenceau. For some reason, a shadow seems to be imposed over her.
(Is this interference?)
The Black Sun hangs in the sky, casting cold light upon the world.
The Black Sun hangs in the sky, casting cold light upon the world.
What the... What's going on here?
Devil sits atop her helmet-shaped rigging, staring at Clemenceau and me with evident surprise.
I've never seen such unmasked emotion from her.
Usually, I'm the one forcing my access to the test site. This is the first time the tables have been turned...
I'm impressed by the rate of your technological innovation.
Excuse me. Were you and I close enough to be casually exchanging greetings?
Careful, or I'll wipe you out right this second.
I'm well aware that you can't actually harm me right now. Let's set the threats aside.
Who told you that? Why are they spilling so much info to you?!
I'll be honest – it was a guess. Thanks for proving me right, though.
Enough. If you have no serious business, then I'm going back to work.
Wait. I do have serious business!
You get one chance. When I get back, I'm tuning my response mechanism so you can't exploit this bug again.
We've only used our trump card for the sake of helping you out. Don't you think we deserve better treatment?
You obviously don't know your place.
Fine... You get TWO. That was one, by the way. Now tell me what you want, already!
What exactly does Hierophant want me to do?
No more headache-inducing riddles, please. Explain it to me like I'm five years old.
Hierophant requires concepts of sufficient strength in order to ascend to a higher dimension.
This test site serves as a reservoir for the energy required.
Does Transcender refer to Hierophant herself, then?
Is she transcending to escape her current circumstances? Or does she have another goal in mind?
What is this Transboundary Experiment?
I don't have the authority to disclose that information.
Alright... What's the meaning of the black towers?
Why are there five of them?
Those? They're just conspicuous targets.
I suggest you blow them all to smithereens in the name of God.
Energy accumulates more efficiently when positive intentions are stimulated.
As for why it's five? We considered 15, 72, and even 999.
Imagine having to destroy 999 of those things, though.
I'd say you had your fill of that dealing with the Buds of the Full Moon.
Was Glorious META's world just another sacrifice for the sake of your Transboundary Experiments?
If we hadn't called Chariot back then... what would have happened?
Every world linked to the buds would have been invaded by Class II mimic entities, yielding countless research samples.
And what happens if we fail to resolve the situation here?
Negative concepts are concepts all the same.
Any other questions? If not, you'd best get moving.
Heheh. Good luck out there.
The Black Sun still hangs high, yet Devil is gone.
Despite the fact that I've gotten some answers, it hasn't put me in a better mood.
Destroy the black towers and make Hierophant's experience a success...
Maybe that is for the best, if it means ending the suffering in this world and allowing it to be reborn.
Even though all this suffering came from Hierophant... no, from the entire Antiochus system.
If they thought it necessary, they would sacrifice themselves. Of course they'd sacrifice everything else just as easily.
All for the sake of ensuring the Magister Plan's success...
To the residents of these test sites, the Arbiters are but executioners to be defied.
Here I am, chatting with those executioners, accepting a gift-wrapped victory, and getting praise and gratitude from people who know nothing of what's going on.
What am I doing...?
How many times has it been? How many times must it happen again?
It's no wonder that Enterprise turned out the way she did.
What kinds of things did she have to witness – to personally endure?
A rift spreads in my heart.
For the first time, self-doubt settles deep inside me.
Commander! You aren't the cause of the suffering happening in these test sites. The Antiochus are not under your control.
If your victories are only a result of their help, then consider that it was YOUR presence that compelled them to do so.
Think of all the test sites you've never experienced. What has happened to them because you weren't there?
Maybe... you're right.
Still, the Magister Plan was put into practice under group agreement. I think that I was among the people who agreed to it.
Is that really true? You lost your memories, did you not?
I did, yes, but this...
The matter was ultimately permitted by the Council, and you participated in its execution.
But does that mean that your past self agreed with it?
I may not be privy to the Council's decision-making process, but surely the passage of any major resolution would require a two-thirds or three-fourths majority.
Can you say with any certainty that you were a member of the majority?
Huh...?
An indescribable chill spreads through me as I come to a sudden realization.
You're right... Why did I take that for granted?
Nobody ever SAID that I voted in support of the Magister Plan.
But all this time, I've quietly accepted the necessity of it and believed that I had to follow the path laid by it.
I never considered understanding it or trying to refine it.
After all, I thought that my past self had devised, agreed to, and had faith in this plan...
But what if I'd always been against it, just like I was against the all-out offensive?
If I had a different vision and different plans in mind...
New thoughts fill the rift, reinforcing it.
Transboundary Experiments are the core of the Magister Plan.
They consume a massive amount of resources from the Arbiter Programs, but they undeniably produce tangible results when it comes to countering the X...
However, if I'm not in a leadership role in this plan – if, in fact, I'm only a disposable pawn...
The Antiochus could continue to amass power through these experiments and find a way to defeat the X on their own. That's what they've always done.
Then for what reason have I ended up in the state I'm in?
What if it isn't because of the Magister Plan, after all?!
My train of thought crashes into a wall. I need more information.
Life isn't as short as we think, Commander. Continue moving forward, and some day, you may remember that which you've lost.
I trust you on this journey, and you ought to trust in yourself, too.
The suffering in these test sites is not your doing, and you're doing everything in your power to save them. Isn't that enough?
...You're right. At this moment, I should be focusing on how to deal with the five towers – not all of the hows or whys.
There's the Commander I know.
Speaking of the hows, there's something I'd like to try on the Iris Orthodoxy's tower.
Allow me to lead the charge and set an example for you.
We don't have enough recon data. There's no telling how sturdy that tower could be.
Moreover, it's surrounded by a thick layer of enemy forces. How are you planning to get through that?
You'll have to wait and see~
Be at ease. I assure you this will be both spectacular and inspiring.
After leaving the Black Sun-affected region behind, I immediately contacted Friedrich der Große and explained the plan to her.
Heehee. Have you solved those riddles already?
More or less. You could say I cheated a little to get the answers.
Clemenceau will handle the tower in Iris territory. Her success will have to be celebrated all throughout the Empire.
To evoke positive feelings, yes? Heehee, I promise that everyone will be singing of this triumph before long.
With that, everything is ready. All that remains is to wait for the good news.
Commander, Clemenceau has already sortied with her fleet.
Are we really going to just stand by and watch...?
She says she'll be fine, and I trust her.
I have a feeling that she's been holding in her emotions about this test site and the catastrophe that befell the Iris Orthodoxy here.
She wants to use her own strength to build a new beginning for the Orthodoxy.
Let's relax and let her handle it.
KABOOOOM!
The enemy defense has been shattered. Our path forward is clear.
The Black Sun makes fighting easier than ever!
Agreed. I feel as if I could fight on forever.
We'll be able to push through to the tower without stopping!
That won't be enough. For the moment, destroying the tower will be impossible.
Escort me no further. If you proceed, you risk getting caught in the destruction.
I plan to deliver a bombastic gift to the netherworld and its tower... All you need to do is witness it.
Algérie, La Galissonnière. Wait here for me, please.
- As you command. - Okaaay!
You've given us a glimmer of hope, Clemenceau... Come back safe to us, please.
Rest assured. I vow to banish darkness and usher in the light of the Iris once more.
Thus, she stepped elegantly into the darkness.
Beneath the distant tower, a legion of sin gathered, ready to overflow at any moment.
A beautiful world has been engulfed in darkness.
The traces of civilization that once lay upon the earth...
This is the Antiochus.
We may share a goal, but there is one fatal difference between us.
*sigh*...
With strength lacking, the only option left is to endure.
Hold fast... and never let go of hope.
Clemenceau raised her gaze to the top of the tower, and then back to the darkness stirring at its base.
Incarnations of wickedness and impurity! In God's name, I pass judgment upon you.
A golden warhorse reared back, and then, bearing a rider, charged forth.
Your first sin: usurpation of righteousness.
A bow-wielding knight on a shining white horse appeared and joined the charge.
Your second sin: trampling over history.
A sword-wielding knight on a blood red horse appeared and joined the charge.
Your third sin: seizure of resources.
A scale-wielding knight on a pitch black horse appeared and joined the charge.
Your fourth sin: wanton slaughter of innocents.
A scythe-wielding knight on a deathly pale horse appeared and joined the charge.
Your fifth sin: depriving society of innovation.
A chorus of voices rang out.
Your sixth sin: elimination of free thought.
The Black Sun hung overhead, setting fire to the black abyss.
Your seventh sin: destruction of civilization.
The Sin Shadow army attempted to launch an assault, but the cold light held them in place as the knights tore through their ranks.
Bring war, and war shall be your reward.
Bring death, and death shall be your reward.
The Black Sun cast away its darkness and radiated blinding light.
Its light pierced the heavens, creating a spectacle visible from even the far reaches of the Empire.
Then, it turned into countless spears of light, which rained down until every inch of the tower was bathed in brilliance.
It's flashy, I'll give her that.
One tower down. Four to go.
The emergence of the black towers caused a panic all throughout the Holy Unitas Empire.
However, it failed to send even a ripple through the Sardegnia League.
Linking our worlds was a lot more surprising than this...
Imagine how our horizons have broadened! I haven't seen everyone this energetic in ages.
Praise be to Her Holiness and her wise decision-making!
Lead us to victory over our foes and a shining future!
Ooohohoho! I love the sound of your cheers! Very good!
You've recorded my heroics, I trust?
Yepperino!
Splendid! I plan to establish a commemorative gallery, and I might just commission you for all of the art. What say you?
It would be an honor, Your Holiness!
Heheh... I'll be filthy rich soon!
Your Apostle has decided! We will obliterate a tower ourselves!
And would you look at that – there's one right on our doorstep.
Ooohohoho! Did you see those spears of light?
The Commander made a show of it. We mustn't be outdone, girls!
Umm... What do you want us to do, exactly?
The Commander should be en route. Arrange a welcome ceremony – the details don't matter, as long as it buys me time.
Raffaello, contact every church in the region and have them tune the Source of God's Light to this frequency.
She hands Raffaello a slip of paper bearing a string of numbers.
This is a new one... Could it be?
The Lattice of God's Light can change modes, too!
I'll have you know that I was the first one to think of using spears of light as weapons.
It's high time I showed everyone the genuine article!
I shall weave a great spear of light from the Lattice of God's Light and deliver a single devastating blow to that unsightly spire!
Let all the world bear witness to an Apostle's power – and give the Commander a good shock in the process! Ooohohoho!

sequence: Do solemnly swear to guard this sacred land.
No matter the price, even my very life...
I shall fight and fight, until...

scripts.say: I swore to fight until either I drew my last breath or we'd achieved total victory in this struggle.
Of the two, I always expected to die on the battlefield... Never did I truly believe that total victory would be ours.
Nor could I imagine that I would witness it myself as a free knight...
Götz's party traveled alongside Sardegnian reinforcements to the southeastern border, hoping to relieve the pressure on Regensburg and her army.
The expedient collapse of two mysterious black structures had greatly bolstered morale, dispelling the ever-present air of gloom and despair that had hung over the Empire for so long.
People along the way are cheering and thanking us! I've never seen everyone in such high spirits!
Our war isn't over yet... but hope is finally here...
Destroy five towers... and it's all over. [2/5 done! (o°▿°)o]
It's like a dream come true... Things have changed a lot in no time.
Heheh... You're right about that.
Maybe we really will survive to see the netherworld vanquished and peace returned to our world.
I don't fear being sunk, but nothing would make me happier than being given the opportunity to rebuild our lost homeland.
I'm reminded of my own ravaged territory.
I'm told that, long ago, it used to be a beautiful place. How I wish I could see it with my own eyes.
Your own territory? That sounds nice... I wonder what reward I'll get when this is all over.
When the war is over... we won't have to deep-dive anymore. We'll lose our budget...
Th-that could be really bad for us...
Is my job in danger...? [NOOOO Σ(ŎдŎ|||)ノ]
I'm sure it won't be so bad. Well, I hope.
Heeehehehe, then it's settled! When we win this war, you're all coming to work in my territory!
Even when the netherworld is gone and we no longer need deep-dives, there will be countless more missions waiting for us!
Sitting atop a gleaming throne, the Emperor perused the reports before her.
The war was not over, but she had already turned her attention to the reconstruction period beyond it.
Land, population, coffers...
Military power, technological advancement, culture and religion...
The Antiochus have reshaped this world profoundly. It has boundless potential, indeed.
If there's any benefit to a world being engulfed by darkness, it's the resulting drop in administrative costs...
Its capacity to serve as a central hub between worlds only adds to its potential.
Nearly half of the spires have fallen in so little time.
In that case...
As ruler of this Empire, I must play my own solo performance.
She cast her gaze beyond the palace's arched ceiling, through the clouds above... and into the world's atmosphere.
In an expanse of outer space called the exosphere, a spindle-shaped object nearly 1 km in length suddenly materialized.
Council Standard Model MK3000: War-Scale Orbital Cannon.
Authorizing: Friedrich der Große.
Target Sector: Former Kamal Union territory.
Target Coordinates: Uploaded.
Let me have but a brief taste of the Ashes' power.
Thus – with all simplicity, expedience, and efficiency – the third spire was obliterated.
After playing her short solo, the Emperor returned to her paperwork.
I must finalize reconstruction policies as soon as possible.
This world will not be able to play the role it was given...
As much as the Ashes need a base...
My child needs it even more.

sequence: Skies above the Holy Unitas Empire

scripts.say: Three of the five imposing towers were gone in no time.
Our impending victory moved as smoothly as a train set on rails.
(The netherworld is like an inferior corrosion phenomenon... so one could liken the Sin Shadows to inferior corrosion entities.)
(In that case, what could the towers be compared to?)
(And then there are Marco Polo and Friedrich der Große...)
(They far surpass the KAN-SEN from other test sites in terms of strength, but they've cultivated that power in a way other than METAmorphosis.)
(The difference is made all the more glaring after seeing Rodney and Pamiat' Merkuria.)
(Upon what principles were the two summoning rituals founded?)
(What kind of secret lies within blueprint ships?)
(Maybe I should retrace all of the clues starting from the moment they arrived in test site beta...)
Commander, we'll reach the southeastern border soon.
Also... Marco Polo is requesting a comms link.
Marco Polo is?
Heheheh. How do you fare, my dear Commander?
Getting carried away already, I see...
Hmph! Butt out, little girl!
I'm the Apostle, so I must project a certain imperious air!
Huh?!
Umm... Marco Polo, this is the command channel. Keep small talk elsewhere, please.
Ahem! I am not here for small talk!
I'm sure all of you are racking your brains over how best to destroy the next tower.
No, we were planning things out very well!
Your Apostle says you were racking your brains! Therefore, you were!
A-anyway! Selfless as I am, I have decided to step in and solve this conundrum for you!
That's a funny way of pronouncing "selfish." Fine... What do you want?
Moments ago, Friedrich der Große stole the spotlight from me. Well, I have devised a plan to outdo her and more!
I'd prefer not to indulge your bizarre competitive streak, but if you'll help us, I'm willing to listen.
This won't cause any collateral damage, will it?
Perish the thought!
Then what is it that you want me to do?
I must focus on preparing the ritual. While I do, you will take your fleet, storm the foot of the tower, and wait for my contact.
See? Quite simple. I will do all the hard work myself, and we can split the glory fifty-fifty!
I guess that's a fair division of labor. Try not to go overboard, please.
Hohoho, worry not! I know exactly what I'm doing!
KABOOOOM!
We fight to our hearts' content, tear them apart until we're sated... and pay back the suffering they've put us through a hundredfold!
The enemy's defenses have crumbled – the tower is in sight! All forces, charge!
Chaaarge! With passion, now!
It's the end of the end... D-don't get hurt now!
Heeehehehe, don't worry~ The Nurse of Nighttime Spooks will take good care of you if you do!
Eep... Yeah, I'd better be careful...
Agreed... [っ ̯ -。]
We must win to usher in a brighter tomorrow!
The Hagiobull Alliance forces march inexorably forward, securing a safe passage from the Imperial barrier all the way to the tower.
Very good! You've done well, warriors!
Now, it is my time!
In the name of the Apostle, I call upon God's gaze...
God, purify this land of filth!
A colossal eye replaces the sun above us.
Is that God's gaze?!
The very same! Fight proudly under the watchful eye of the divine!
Under the gaze of that giant eye, the black tower crumbles.
All of the netherworld around it turns into harmless grey.
Commander, my holy ritual is complete. Impressed, I presume?
I hate to say it, but I am. Nobody can match Marco Polo when it comes to spectacle.
Ooohohoho!
Hohoho... Oh? I suddenly feel weak...
What's happening to me?

sequence: Skies above the Holy Unitas Empire

scripts.say: After her reckless overuse of Hierophant's power, Marco Polo unsurprisingly fell into a deep sleep.
According to Raffaello, she was sleeping soundly with a smile on her face.
Is it just me, or does this keep happening?
She comes in like a hurricane, saves the day, and then goes straight to sleep...
It must be fun living the way she does.
One can't help but envy her...
Hmm... We can discuss her habits another time.
The ritual she performed at the end seems to have pushed the experiment to a new stage.
Even while she sleeps, the netherworld is still being transformed.
At this rate, it may very well disappear from this world altogether in just a few hours.
I wish it would take the last tower with it...
There's no telling what will happen there. Let's have everyone wait and watch for now.
Commander, the destruction of the netherworld is slowing.
It seems the area around the tower is resisting it the most... Some areas have stopped changing entirely.
It can never be easy, can it? Prepare all units for battle–
KABOOOOM!
What's going on? Why did the defense system just activate?
Flying objects detected on radar... Wait, what is this?!
Commander, emergency! Something has happened on the front line!
Transmitting recon plane footage now!
Darkness parts from the water's surface and rises as a great, dark wall.
It takes a few seconds for me to parse what I'm seeing in the footage.
The netherworld... used the last of its power to create flying enemies?
Our so-called wall is actually a flood of black enemies, closing in on the Holy Unitas Empire like a plague of locusts.
It's enough to make you think the world is ending.
The netherworld's death throes... Here I was, ready to let the locals end this with their own hands.
Memphis, get me in contact with Friedrich der Große.
BEEP BEEP!
I'm here, my child.
The enemy is launching a counterattack. We need to destroy that tower immediately – can you use that orbital strike of yours again?
It's primed and ready.
Destroy that tower and end this.
I would be happy to grant your wish, my child.
KABOOOOM!
Divine light rains down from above, wiping the final tower off the face of this planet.
However...
The Sin Shadows aren't disappearing – they're only becoming more frenzied!
Urgh... I don't like this one bit!
Everyone, hold the barrier and fire at will! We must reduce their numbers at once!
Friedrich, Commander! We can't hold the defensive line much longer!
The situation devolves into chaos.
With the towers destroyed, the netherworld blanketing the planet has been reduced to harmless ash.
However, the enemy's final assault is a different story.
Each individual foe is weak and easily destroyed.
Yet they are innumerable. Like a swarm of locusts, their overwhelming onslaught pushes the Imperial barrier to the brink of collapse.
We can't let our guard down for an instant.
Even if we achieve victory on every front, our defenses will ultimately be crushed by their sheer numbers.
Our front line remaining intact won't matter if our rear guard is engulfed in a sea of flames.
You won't need to worry about them.
In accordance with my identity, I will continue to maintain the Imperial barrier from this throne until the very end.
My child, how do you plan to tackle this new mystery?
It's possible that this situation is another message from Hierophant.
For example... maybe she's saying that the last counter-offensive was similar to this one.
Or that she felt this same sense of powerlessness fighting the X.
She must be trying to make me understand the essence of this problem – and her solution.
The Transcender Plan, a means of going to a higher dimension...
If so, then the solution to our predicament must be in there somewhere.
If only I can comprehend the true meaning of the Transcender...
But in the here and now, we're suffering casualties. I can't waste time solving riddles.
Memphis, contact Clemenceau for me.
BEEP BEEP!
Commander?
Clemenceau, I want you to construct a ritual using the Black Sun.
This experiment is nearing its end, so I want to take one more shortcut... and meet its designer in person.
She seems to be trying to send me a message, so why not talk it out directly?
As for the concept of "Pontifex" necessary for the ritual...
Let's have Marco Polo shine one last time.
The Black Sun rises high into the sky before vanishing in an instant.
I stand alone in endless white.
Hierophant stands motionless like a statue.
Her figure is ethereal, like a bubble that could burst at the slightest of touches.
There is no response. No light in her eyes.
I thought that your situation would improve as the experiment progressed.
But now, you look even more fragile than before...
There is no response. No light in her eyes.
Right... Let me ask a clear question.
I want to know more about the Transboundary Experiment.
I seek answers from the phantom before me.
Shortly after, a door pops into existence.
When I reach out and touch it, the world in front of me transforms.
In a spacious laboratory, a single familiar figure writes something down on a whiteboard.
If one wished to direct the Pontifex's communicative abilities toward the X, how would they go about it?
First, they must be on the same dimension.
That is the foundation of communication. Information on a different level becomes meaningless.
There are two methods of satisfying this requirement. Either we go to the X's dimension, or we bring them down to ours.
Unfortunately, the second is infeasible.
All X on the same dimension as us are merely derivative beings without rational minds.
Communicating with them is thus an exercise in futility, and meaningless at that.
We are left with one option: to transcend from our own dimension.
Theoretically, this is a simple process.
A substance can be replicated at a higher dimension by creating projections of it at every instant in time.
With a large enough sample size, we can reach the X no matter which dimension they reside in.
Unfortunately, this can only be verified by the girls themselves after the Magister Plan is executed.
By going beyond test site alpha – through the use of infinite test sites...
...Hah. Infinite test sites provide more than just infinite possibilities.
Next, one must identify information that can be used for communication.
Sight, smell, hearing, touch... The essence of communication lies in the effective exchange of information between two parties in the same dimension.
Based on current research, I have doubts regarding whether the X can be considered a distinct higher-dimensional entity.
They're more of... a rule, or perhaps a phenomenon generated by a certain rule.
But this phenomenon is accompanied by a wealth of information.
The foundation of communication therefore exists, but the problem lies in the parties involved.
Even if they contain information, if the X cannot be viewed as a distinct entity...
Could that information be reorganized to change the X... or even create an entity for the X?
Or could I reorganize the X's information using myself as a base... and control it?
Could it be polluted with an overload of information to disrupt its original structure, causing chaos, contradictions, and confusion... thus creating weaknesses?
To do so would allow mortals to be as gods.
Hierophant, if you can accomplish this someday, then I will give you a new title.
You will be... the Transcender.
In the boundless white, the phantom-like statue silently watches me.
So this is where the name comes from...
To elevate you to the same dimension as the X and influence them... That was the true goal.
(But why did it need to be done after the Magister Plan?)
(If we'd concentrated our efforts on the experiment from the start...)
A sheet of paper-cut art appears in the space between us.
Two stick figures are illustrated on it. One sits atop a conch shell, while the other is wearing a conductor's hat and waving.
Are these stick figures... me and you, Hierophant?
There is no response, but the paper-cut art changes.
The stick figure with the hat hasn't changed, but the one sitting atop the conch gradually thickens.
Stickers appear all over the art piece and gather around the figure.
The figure atop the conch begins to stick out of the art until becoming a three-dimensional figure indistinguishable from the statue. The one with the hat continues to wave from within the paper.
When the three-dimensional one reaches down to grab the other, the paper disappears.
(I see... That's why they need so many test sites. It all makes sense now.)
(Wait... I haven't even asked my question yet. How did Hierophant know?!)
Are you able to read my mind directly?
The phantom statue remains silent as another door appears nearby.
When I reach out and touch it, the world in front of me transforms.
That's right.
If you can read my mind, then why are you waiting for me to ask my next question out loud?
Another door appears nearby.
What are you trying to tell me?
When I reach out and touch it, the world in front of me transforms.
It was necessary in the past, but now, it's more about the custom, you see.
...I see.
It makes sense why you chose Marco Polo as your proxy now...
Back on topic – you must realize why I've contacted you today.
I've had enough of riddles. I want to solve the crisis in ES-40111 without further casualties.
Would you please just give me the answer?
The phantom statue flickers, seemingly lost in thought.
Another door appears nearby.
I sure hope this one will answer me...
When I reach out and touch it, the world in front of me transforms.
Okay! No problem! I'll tell you!
However...
Every shortcut comes at a price.
A price...?
Hierophant's statue suddenly comes face-to-face with me.
Though it's an illusion, it's somehow chilly to the touch.
There's a feeling of weightlessness as my vision is drawn sharply upward.
Ripped out of the white expanse, I find myself in the sky above the Holy Unitas Empire, overlooking the battlefield.
I experienced this at the Martyrium...
As I gaze at the black locusts blanketing the landscape, Hierophant follows suit.
I haven't seen such a lively look on her face since the "perfect future."
Transboundary Experiment #1: Transcender.
Stage 1: Concept filtration barrier. Success.
Stage 2: Energy reservoir. Success.
Stage 3: Conceptual staircase. In progress.
Wherever her gaze goes, the black locusts turn into harmless ash.
Where the five towers stood, new white towers rise.
Stage 3: Conceptual staircase. Success.
Beginning ascent.
Hierophant and the five white towers disappear.
I suddenly begin to plummet. My vision rapidly shrinks.
Talk about a shortcut... The danger has all but passed.
Huh? That's odd... I'm suddenly sleepy...
Fatigue washes over me like a tidal wave. My consciousness drifts beyond reach.
Just before my mind fades, I hear a beautiful voice.
AOHUR FVB, JVTTHUKLY
KV UVA DVYYF. ZSLLW
H UHW DPSS ZLYCL FVB DLSS
Good night...
And good luck, Hierophant...
I don't remember much of what happened after I said goodbye to Hierophant.
I must've fallen into a deep sleep, because all of the sounds around me were hazy.
[Commander]... [This]...
[Link with the Compiling Field]...
[Don't worry]... [Merely]...
Memphis and Helena seem concerned for my safety, but Clemenceau manages to soothe them.
Before long, it seems I've been taken to Brandenburg Palace.
[I must be leaving]... [Look forward to your growth]...
Friedrich der Große says something to me.
[Commencing ritual]... [Send you back]...
[A precious world]... [Important duty]...
[Tribunal]... [Remain for a time]... [To restore order]...
[Take Marco Polo with you]...
[Stabilizing channel]... [Rebuilding link]...
Clemenceau seems to be saying something, too.
After that, I hear Prinz Eugen and Z2's voices.
It seems I'm back on the Tribunal's Hand.
After that, the world is engulfed in dazzling light.
The journey is finally over...
I can rest for once...

sequence: Before the Hagiobull, an alliance was forged.
And sail toward the horizon of hope.
Alliance Before the Hagiobull - The End

scripts.say: As the light fades, my mind finally clears up.
Nothing... feels wrong.
Far from it, I'm refreshed, as if I've just had the best sleep of my life.
Was I forced to rest?
Whatever the intent behind that was, it turned out for the better for me.
We are home, right?
I gaze out the window to find bushes, weeds, and the mangled ruins of a palace.
Memphis and Helena are still asleep.
Mainz, Prinz Eugen, Z2... Nobody's woken up yet, huh?
Clemenceau is gone... Same goes for Algérie and La Galissonnière. I guess they stayed...
Heh... I was the last one to wake up on the way there, but this time, I'm the first.
Guess that makes us even.
Nngh... Is this the Tribunal's Hand?
There's a familiar voice.
Oh? Commander...? I thought you all went home already.
Am I dreaming right now?
Carabiniere?
Why are you with us?
With you...? What did you mean?
Wait a second! With you... D-does that mean this isn't a dream, and I've really left with you?!
How could this have happened?!
I don't have the faintest idea how.
Maybe you were brought back with us by mistake because our contract isn't fulfilled yet?
Ooh... Now that you mention it, that does make sense! You haven't paid me yet!
Can I have my money now?
Surely receiving your money won't send you back home... How about we just extend your contract instead?
Extend it?
This is test site beta. I'd like you to act as my bodyguard until we find a way to send you home.
A mercenary contract that goes beyond worlds... That sounds cool! I'd love to!
As Commander of the Azur Lane, I formally welcome you to test site beta, Carabiniere. Make yourself at home.
You gave us a tour of your world before.
It's time we returned the favor.

sequence: One day, after the netherworld's defeat...

scripts.say: A single salvage vessel drifted atop muted waves.
Eugh... Too choppy!
Even without enemies around, the North Sea is no place for sailing!
The war is over... We ought to be lying around the manor and enjoying life!
I knew we shouldn't have taken this job...
But rebuilding the territory costs money, and Moritz's coffers are bone-dry already...
I tried to turn it down, too, but the Archbishop of Köln offered such a tantalizing price!
She even promised to have the Royal Artisans' Guild handle my castle's repairs!
Plus, she gave me this incredible divine salvage vessel to use as a base, free of charge!
How could I refuse a deal that good?
At least... we're all together... [Salvaging is fun! o(*//▿//*)q]
To think, we've gone from Imperially-sanctioned netherworld deep-dive team to treasure-hunting and salvaging in the sootworld.
Recovering fragments of civilization from ashen waters... It's meaningful work.
Though I'd have preferred it if it wasn't in the North Sea.
*sigh*... How do you think Commander {playername} is doing? Last I recall, our good friend was being hauled off somewhere.
Someone's awfully interested!
I could try digging around for updates when we get back.
Yes, I am interested.
Truth be told, Commander {playername} ended up in that state as a result of saving our world...
It wouldn't be proper noble etiquette if I didn't offer my thanks in person.
You don't have to worry so much~ One of our mercenaries went with the Commander.
The two of them might just come back someday. When they do, we'll throw a magnificent victory party!
I hope we're not still in the North Sea when that time comes...
Huh?! [A shocking realization! Σ(っ°Д°;)っ]
Well said! All the more reason to get this job done quickly!
I wish you'd said no to this jooob!
Before returning to PH harbor, I brought Marco Polo back to the Compiling Field.
The atmosphere here is markedly somber.
After all, they failed to pinpoint the coordinates of test site ES-40111 until the exact moment I arrived home.
I'm so sorry, Commander...
It's okay. That was a special test site for Transboundary Experiments, so it's no surprise that it was difficult to find.
Right...
I'll be leaving Marco Polo in your hands. If anything seems wrong with her, call me immediately.
Understood! We'll keep an eye on her!
By the way, is Yorktown here? I'd like to talk to her.
She just departed for test site ES-40111.
Huh?
She said she wanted to conduct a field study there.
According to her, the fact that Friedrich der Große and Clemenceau put so much importance on that test site means they have the same ideas in mind as her.
I do recall Clemenceau saying something about stabilizing channels and establishing links...
Exactly. That test site has the potential to serve as a rear base.
A rear base, huh?
By taking the experiment mechanisms that have joined us and positioning them there, we can use their potential to the fullest!
Hold on a second. We should consider the situation at the test site... Oh, but they are used to Siren technology, I guess...
Exactly.
The technology used to interface with test sites looks like magic, and it's extremely rare to boot.
It's only my second time seeing it!
That's why Yorktown went to investigate – she wants to understand this technology inside and out.
If we can apply it on a large scale, we'll be able to connect the resources and energy of every test site!
By connecting test sites, we can help others escape their shackles. Every little bit helps, huh?
If that day comes... that would be amazing.
A girl opened her eyes amidst city ruins.
Where am I...
Why... am I here?
My head hurts... I can't remember a thing.
She stood up and tried to make sense of the situation she'd found herself in.
However, the blinding neon lights all around made it difficult to see what was beyond them.
City ruins... but with neon lights?
Something isn't right.
She stood by the roadside and gazed upon the city before her.
Skyscrapers towered all around. Car traffic was endless. Neon lights colored the sky like an unsleeping city.
This place is weird...
Hi there, fellow traveler. Finally awake?
A petite girl sat perched on the railing of a pedestrian bridge. Upon noticing Essex, she smiled and waved.
You came to the wrong place at the wrong time, giving you a glimpse into this world's true nature.
A lot of people ignorant of the truth have disappeared without a trace.
But you got lucky... You made it out alive.
Anyone who can survive the first night on their own tends to live a long life.
Fellow traveler...?
Hmm? Aren't you an investigator brought here by the anomalies?
No wonder you aren't disguised... Here I thought you were just cocky.
Disguise...?
Yeah! Making yourself invisible and blending in with your surroundings, a lot like I am.
Heheh, see? Even you can't tell the difference.
That disguise... What are you?
And what is this city?
"The light-chasing moth is finally revealed by the flame."
Patience, okay? I'll set you up with a disguise – for now, let's get you to a safe place so we can talk.
A dream. When I open my eyes, I'm in a brightly lit classroom.
After that meeting with Bismarck and Sovetsky Soyuz, I reviewed their strategic reports... and I must have fallen asleep during?
Which brings me here...
The fact that I'm in a classroom instead of on campus grounds must mean... that Madam M called me here.
I look around, but I'm the only person in the room.
An empty classroom?
What déjà vu...
Suddenly, I realize there's a girl wearing a white dress in front of me.
Her presence feels so natural, almost like she's been standing here the whole time.
Did you summon me?
Was it you last time, too?
Not me. Her.
Her...?
She is coming.
*knock* *knock*
There's a knock at the door.
Hello? Excuse me...
I heard that class was being held here today...
Huh?!
Déjà vu all over again.
Don't run. Sit down.
This time, the space doesn't collapse.
Professor?

options.content: Is it too late to run?!

scripts.say: ...Hi there.
Bon Homme Richard...?
Is it too late to run?!

sequence: 「騎士、ゲッツ・フォン・ベルリヒンゲン」
「この聖印の前で厳粛に誓いを立てます」
「至高なる神光の名のもとに」
「英明神武なる皇帝の名のもとに」
「私は黒き領域に立ち向かい」
「全ての邪悪に立ち向かうと違います」
「いかなる代償を払おうとも、命を惜しまず」
「必ずやこの聖なる地を守り抜いてみせます」

scripts.say: 白い光の中、万籟は静寂に沈む。
感覚そのものが何かに遮断されたかのように、全てが虚無へと変わった。
（なんか見覚えのある展開だな……）
眼前に広がる純白の景色を見つめる時、その純白の景色もまたこちらを見つめている。
どれほどの時が流れたのだろうか、白い光から世界が色を取り戻した。
指揮官、大丈夫？気分が悪かったりしない？
視界の色彩が戻ると同時に、メンフィスとヘレナが心配してくれている様子が目に入った。
――大丈夫だ……こういうのはもう慣れてる
――二人とも無事で良かった。自分より早く意識が戻ったのか？
指揮官より少しだけ先ね……
クレマンソーたちは周辺の環境調査に出かけたわ。でも窓の外の景色から判断する限りでは……
――……窓の外の景色？
振り返って窓の外を眺めた。陽光が野原を照らし、溢れんばかりの緑に違和感は特にない。
ただ――
――……手入れされている芝生だ。城も……廃墟ではなくなってる…
そうかもしれないわ～
クレマンソーののんびりした声が突然、座席の脇のスピーカーから流れてきた。
周辺区域の安全確認が済んだけど、人の姿は確認できなかったわ
まだキャビンから出ないでね。今の状況に合わせるため、審判号にちょっとした調整を加えなきゃならないから
――ちょっとした調整って……？
ふふ、これを見て――
天井から突然ディスプレイが降りてきて、「審判号」の構造図が映し出された。
では、始めるわ♪
クレマンソーの声と共にキャビンが規則的に揺れ始めると、ディスプレイ上の飛行機の構造も同時に変化し始めた。
機首、主翼、エンジン…飛行機を構成する各モジュールが変化している。
これは単なる変形ではない。一部のモジュールは突如消え、別のモジュールが最初からそこにあったかのように出現している。
そしてこの変化は目の前にも現れ始めた。キャビンの壁と床が変化の中で再構築され、空間も展延していく。
数分のうちに、快適だったキャビンは視界の開けた指揮室へと変貌していた。
そして飛行機もまた変貌を遂げ、まるで巨大な陸用の……基地車両のような姿に変わっていた。
――これは……まさかアンチエックスと同じ製造技術？
――いや……審判号にこれほどの最先端技術が搭載されているなら、この前はどうしてトレーラーなんて必要としてたんだ……？
さすが指揮官……とてもユニークな着眼点ね
一つに、審判号の性能を隠したかったからよ。なにせこれは審判廷の専用機だからね
それに、「飛行機」を滑走路以外で移動させるには当然「トレーラー」が必要でしょ？
この手の飛行機は滑走路なしで離陸できないのと同じように、これもいわゆる「属性」と「象徴」みたいなものよ
これに関しては「エリザベス」のおかげね。彼女の列車を見てこのアイデアが浮かんだから
もっと詳しく知りたいなら、今度時間がある時にゆっくり話してあげるわ
…今は、他にやらなきゃならないことがあるから
指揮用の台からホログラムが浮かび上がった。どうやら車外にいるクレマンソーは審判号を遠隔操作できるようだ。
派遣した偵察ドローンがさっき消息を絶ったわ。ちょうど写真のあの区域の境界を越えた瞬間にね
偵察情報からは、周囲の緑豊かな風景とは明らかに異質な黒い領域が見えた。
異質な気配が漂っているその領域は、まるで人為的に大地から無理矢理切り取られた沼地の塊のようだ。
――レーダー探知結果は？
レーダーはその区域を一切感知してないわ。あそこには何もないし、何も問題がないってね
でも実際は、偵察ドローンが進入しただけで連絡が途絶えたの
――なるほど、わかった
指揮官、もしかして今から……
――ああ、調べに行くよ
――ここに巻き込まれたのは、ハイエロファントが見せた兆候を調査するためだ
――彼女の目的を分析する前に、まずは目の前の状況を把握しなければ
――時間が惜しい、早く出発しよう
――そういえば……
――そういえば……審判号は陸上で自動操縦できるの？
できなくはないけど、ここの地形データが不足してるから、私が直接運転した方が安全だと思うわ
ふふ、久しぶりの運転だから、なんだかワクワクしちゃう
それでは、出発しましょ
加速、ブレーキ、そして再加速。
審判号にはサスペンションが本当にあるのか疑いたくなるほどの荒い運転だった。
これは予想外ね……知ってたらZ2に運転させたほうがマシだったかもしれないわ
聞こえてるわよ
あはは……
ちょっとした喧噪の後、審判号は黒色の沼の境界線を越えることができた。
そして再び形態を変え、今度は指揮艦へと形を変えた。
――やっぱりこっちの形態の方がいいな
窓から区域内部の景色を細かく観察した。
ここは鏡面海域のような独立した空間のようだが、外部からも観測可能な通常の鏡面海域とは違うようだ。
しかし内部空間は外部からの観測よりも明らかに広大で、漆黒の水の深さも想像がつかない。
この水の上は立った感触が……あまり良くないわね
奇遇ね……あたしも同じ感想よ
――まずい……まさかMETA化侵食？
そうじゃないみたい……体にも装備にも異常はないわ
でも、この黒い深淵から……極めて強い負の感情を感じる
META化現象に似てるけど……ううん、むしろそれ以上に深刻かもしれないわ
我も立ってみようか？
大丈夫よ。もう見当はついてるわ……こんなこともあろうかと準備をしてきたの
指揮官、審判号のバリアシステムなら十分対処できると思うわ
――艦外の全員は直ちに帰艦せよ。クレマンソー、バリアを起動してくれ
待って！指揮官、レーダーが高速接近中の不明物体を多数捕捉したわ！
――……やはり敵がいるのか。クレマンソー、バリアで対処できる？
今起動しようとしてるバリアでは物理攻撃を防げないけど、周囲に安全に戦えるエリアを作り出すことは可能よ
――わかった。命令変更だ。指揮艦周辺に留まり、バリア内で守りを固めてくれ！
――移動しながら、敵を殲滅する！
敵の数は多かったものの、戦いは想像以上に楽勝だった。
未確認の新種だったが、どこか侵食天象と共に現れる侵食具現体を連想した。
しかし戦闘力では、通常の侵食具現体を大きく下回っていた。
こうして戦いは順調に推移した。
戦闘が終盤に差し掛かった時、バリア外から一つの影が駆け寄ってきた。
すごくかっこいい「神の戦車」ですね！もしかして、あなたたちは「聖印同盟軍」の掃討部隊ですか！？
あっ、申し遅れました！
自由傭兵の「カラビニエーレ」であります！今は領地内の「黒き領域」の浸透問題を解決すべく、レーゲンスブルク大司教のもとで働いております！
まさか運良く正規軍に会えるなんて！今日の任務は楽に終わりそうです！
「カラビニエーレ」の通信を終えると、艦橋はなんとも言えない微妙な空気に包まれた。
指揮官……ほかの実験場でも毎回こんな感じなの？
――それぞれの実験場で違うけど……こういう時もあるな
「カラビニエーレ」はさっき「黒き領域」と言ってたね
それと、神のなんちゃらとも……うーん……
――まだなんとも言えないな……でも現地の者と仲良くしておいて損はないはずだ
――クレマンソー、とりあえずこっちの正体を明かさずに上手く話を合わせよう。「カラビニエーレ」に共闘の意思を示してくれ
――この「黒き領域」に現地の者がどうやって対処するか見てみたい
――ほかのことは、目の前の危機を解決してから話そう
ふふ、了解よ
うん――密集した敵を十分に削げましたね。新しい敵も出てきていない……これは好機です！
携行型自動消散装置――起動！
装置の起動と共に、空間の至る所で斉唱が同時に鳴り響いた。
斉唱の内容を聞き分ける暇もなく、黒き領域は瞬く間に崩壊していった。
ふふん♪これで依頼完了であります！
戦闘終了後、審判号を基地車両の形態に戻し、一行は応接室で「カラビニエーレ」と対面した。
お互いの認識のズレが大きく、案の定自己紹介はあまりスムーズには進まなかった。
……聖印同盟軍ではなく、外からの来訪者……ですか？
……あっ！わかりました！外からの来訪者という傭兵団ってことですね！？
あなたたちの傭兵団はすごい強さですね！まさか神の戦車まで持っているなんて！
「審判号」と言うんですね！……まさに神の戦車にふさわしい名前です！
一瞬「カラビニエーレ」に事情を説明しようと思ったが、セイレーンや実験場のことから始めるには煩雑すぎる……
――「カラビニエーレ」の言う通り、自分たちは傭兵団「外からの来訪者」だ
「カラビニエーレ」はメンフィスやヘレナたちの名前には反応せず、クレマンソーに対しても特別な反応を示さなかった。
だが、プリンツ・オイゲンを見た時には神妙な面持ちになり、マインツを見るや否や、その場で固まってしまった。
……「カラビニエーレ」？どうかしたのか？
まさか、マインツが……
マインツで……間違いない……
マインツ大司教が殉国した後、後を継いだマインツ大司教が……まさか艦船だったなんて！？
これならあなたたちの傭兵団の強さの説明がつきますね……！
でも……選挙侯の位は聖印盟約書に基づき、レーゲンスブルク大司教が継承したはずですが……
大変であります…！これは面白いことに……ゴホン、大変なことになるのであります！
クレマンソーと顔を見合わせた後、二人してプリンツ・オイゲンの目配せに気づいた。
簡単なやり取りの後、こうして、会話から情報を引き出す役目はオイゲンに回った。

（今回もそういった装置があるんだろうか……）
ストラスブール市での諸事務を終えると、陽はもう地平線に沈んでいた。
ここの城と大聖堂にのみ「神の機械」による電灯があるが、他の区域の照明はまばらな松明とオイルランプがあるのみだった。
そのため、夜になると都市のほとんどが闇に包まれていた。
世界博覧会の時の水中装置が気になってクレマンソーに会いに行くと、そこで意外な人物と出会った。
はじめまして{playername}閣下。私は「エルベ」ですわ。お会いできて嬉しいですの……
――こんにちは、「エルベ」
――顔色が優れないようだが……何かあったのか？
ご心配感謝しますの。はあ、本当はマインツ選挙侯の件についてクレマンソーに色々聞こうと思ってましたけど…
今となっては……その問題も瑣事になってしまったようですの
……本当に穏やかではない夜ですの
実はここへ来る途中で急報を受け取りまして……黒き領域からの攻勢が強まったそうですの
前線がピンチってことかしら？
ランス市の方面の戦況は危険で……トリーア大司教と随行の護教軍が全滅、聖印同盟軍の防衛線も崩壊寸前だそうですの
……七大選挙侯がまた一人欠けるとは、重大な損失ね
でもこれで……マインツの問題も確かに問題ではなくなったわ
――……その「問題」とか「問題じゃない」とかって……どういう意味なんだ？
うちのマインツの身分に関することよ
選挙侯とは、その名の通り投票によって帝国皇帝を選出できる強力な諸侯のこと
この神聖総連帝国の「聖印盟約書」の規定によれば、選挙侯は全部で七人で、原則としてそれぞれの継承順位に基づいて選ばれるみたいだけど
帝国が重大な危機に直面した時、艦船の優先順位に沿って選出されるようになっているわね
さっきのトリーア大司教は選挙侯の一人で、艦船マインツは選挙侯の継承条件に合致する存在…
だから明日には、うちのマインツがこの選挙侯になるわね
――自分たちは「外部からの訪問者」なのにか？
ご心配に及びません。重要なのは「兆し」に明確に対応するかどうかと…
……私たちに協力する意思があるかどうか、ですわ
――もちろんだ。そのために来た
――その複雑な話は一旦置いといて――
――聖印同盟軍というのは確か……この神聖総連帝国と、全ての残存同盟の軍隊で構成された連合軍のことだったか？
――ランス市方面に艦船はいるのか？持ちこたえられそうか？
ええ……アイリスの国土の大部分は黒き領域に飲み込まれてしまいましたけど、ランス方面の防衛線は依然として強固ですわ
アイリスの残存主力軍は全員そこにいますので、一晩ぐらいは問題ないはずですの
でも、あと何日持つかまではなんとも……
すでに夜通しで援軍を召集しましたわっ…なんとか二日以内に増援を出せればいいので……
――それでは遅すぎるかもしれないな…
――自分たちが先に支援に向かおう。運河網は夜でも使えるのか？
メンテナンス作業を停止すれば使用可能ですわ……すぐに起動してきますのっ
――クレマンソー、他の仲間にも知らせてくれ。今すぐ出発だ
もう連絡したわよ。「カラビニエーレ」たちも引き続き私たちと共に行動してくれるみたいよ
全員、「審判号」に向かってるはず
――わかった。自分たちも早く向かおう
――この世界の脅威の源を、直接この目で見る時が来たみたいだ
……ランス市のことをお願いいたします。神の輝きが私たちを勝利へと導きますように…
光のない夜に、黒い奔流が波状攻撃を仕掛け続けている。
大地と黒き領域の曖昧な境界線は、うねり、変化し、やがて復元不可能な侵食になる。
ようやく第十七波の攻勢を退けた……本当に大変な夜だ
アルディたちは今、洪水の中の防波堤のようなものね…いくら持ちこたえても、背後の土地は……
……アルディちゃん、全員が持ち場を堅守しましょう。洪水はいずれ過ぎ去るものですわ
scripts.actorName: デュゲイ・トルーアン

scripts.say: ……真面目なことも言うんだね…
もちろんですよ～。暗闇の中で信念を貫くのは聖職者ですから～
scripts.actorName: デュゲイ・トルーアン

scripts.say: はあ……とにかく、黒き領域に飲み込まれてから、全ての通信連絡も途絶えちゃったの。援軍が来るかどうかもわからないね
……これほどの規模の侵攻だもの。神聖総連帝国はきっと異変に気付いてるはず
ただ時間を考えると……増援の到着にあと二日以上かかるかもしれないわ
二日か……私たちが防衛に専念してれば、きっとあっという間よ
そうですね～。いざとなれば聖物を一気に使うという手もありますし
scripts.actorName: デュゲイ・トルーアン

scripts.say: そうすれば、どんなに強い悪魔の軍勢でも灰燼に帰すはずですわ～
scripts.actorName: デュゲイ・トルーアン

scripts.say: ……そこまでの状況にならないことを切に願うよ
皆、新たな攻勢が来るぞ
はあ……これで第十八波ね。みんな頑張りましょ～！
指揮官……前方の敵の排除が完了したわ。前進可能よ
――ああ、進軍再開だ
――クレマンソー、もっと偵察ドローンを出してくれ。一刻も早くアイリス艦隊を見つけなければならない！
夜通し進み続け、一行はようやく帝国の西部前線に到着した。
冷兵器と悪意の影が戦う不条理と、そして神への賛歌を高らかに歌いながら死守する決意を目の当たりにした。
また、黒き領域の中にいるアイリス艦隊が「神聖浄化」の儀式の準備中で、防衛線にある軍勢に後退の指令を出したという情報も掴んだ。
――全軍後退……「神聖浄化」とやらは、まさか敵と刺し違えるための手段じゃないだろうな…
――早く彼女たちを見つけなければ！
指揮官、ドローンが目標位置を発見した！でも……映像がちょっとおかしいわ…！
指揮室に転送する――
ドローンから送られてきた映像には、量産型を伴わないアイリス艦隊の姿があった。
彼女たちは海面で円形に布陣している。
円陣の中心から放たれている金色の光は周囲の敵を寄せ付けない力を有しているようで、その周辺の水本来の黒色から灰色に変えている。
あれがおそらく神聖浄化儀式ね……指揮官、光の中心は見える？
――光の中心……
目を凝らして観察すると、そこには神聖すら思わせる金色の光で構成された、四角い物体が空中に浮かんでいる。
――あれは何だ……？
指揮官、艦船は何人見える？
――ええと、5人だ……
――いや…実体がある5人以外に…かすかに5つの虚像も見える……？
見えるのね……どうやら私の推測もおそらく間違っていないみたいね。あれはきっとオリジンキューブよ
――……金色の……オリジンキューブ？？
彼女たちの持っている技術は、おそらく私の持つ「黒き太陽」と同じ体系だわ
「黒き太陽」が起動すると、その核であるオリジンキューブも金色に変わるわ……ほんの一瞬ではあるけど
もしかしたら……この実験場で謎が解けるかもしれない
あとは私に任せて。儀式を中断させ、彼女たちを救う方法はあるわ
黒き太陽が中天に懸かる。
「審判」の象徴たる存在の下、悪意の影は瞬く間に灰燼に帰した。
……えっ？
あれは……一体…？
scripts.actorName: デュゲイ・トルーアン

scripts.say: こちらの介入でアイリス艦隊を救えただけでなく、周辺の広大な区域も安全になった。
黒き領域が駆逐された後、一部の大地だけ元の姿に戻ったものの、残りの部分は成分のわからない灰白色の結晶へと変わっていた。
黒き領域に長く侵食された土地はこうなってしまうわ……今回一部でも元に戻せたのは奇跡みたいなものよ
ところで、あなたたちは……？
「エルベ」の依頼で駆けつけてきた援軍の先遣部隊よ。本隊は二日以内に到着するわ
ふぅ……よかった。聖印同盟軍が私たちを見捨てるはずないもの
ここは私たちに任せて。そっちは一度下がるの？それとも……？
もちろん、他の拠点の支援に向かいますわ～
scripts.actorName: デュゲイ・トルーアン

scripts.say: 私の推測が間違っていなければ、あなたはアイリスのご出身ですよね？一緒に行動しませんか？
scripts.actorName: デュゲイ・トルーアン

scripts.say: あいにくだけど、今はこの「外からの来訪者」傭兵団に入っている身よ。機会があれば一緒に戦いましょう
ところで、この「黒き太陽」の威力を目にしたでしょうけど…
この戦いを一刻も早く終わらせるために、あなたたちの「神聖浄化儀式」と……その他すべての儀式に関する資料がほしいわ
戦いを終わらせる……
ごめんなさい。協力したいのは山々だけど、ほとんどの資料がある大聖堂はもう、教国の首都と共に黒き領域に飲み込まれてしまったわ
大聖堂のバリアはまだ持ちこたえているかもしれないけど、あそこへ至る道はすでに……
そうなのね……わかったわ
今は確かに無理をすべきじゃないわね。こっちも地道に進みましょう
短い休息の後、アイリス教国艦隊はこちらに礼を述べると、次の戦場へと向かっていった。
それを見届けた後、今後の戦闘配置について考え始めたところ――
その時、予想外の人物がやってきた。
改めて感謝を申し上げますわ。尊敬する{playername}閣下
アイリス軍を救ってくださりありがとうございます。おかげで聖印同盟軍の戦力が削がれずに済みました
――あの「神聖浄化儀式」の様子を見るに、使うのは初めてじゃない……よな？
……その通りよ
残念ながら……「っ ̯ -」
あなたたちがここまで強いとは思ってませんでした
謎が多いですが……私たちの味方で本当によかったです
（謎が多い、か……）
（それはお互い様だ……）
「黒き太陽」の助けで、ランス市の防衛はそう困難ではなくなった。
これで、黒き領域の性質を至近距離で調査する絶好の機会を得た。
クレマンソーが前もって「審判号」に研究室モジュールを設置してくれたおかげで、サンプルを収集することができた。
分析作業については……同行している研究員がいないものの――
オリジンキューブが金色に……？そんな情報は初耳ね……
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: まさか、偽神事件よりずっと前に起きてたなんて……
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: そちらの状況は本当に……コホン、すばらしいわね。さすがはナンバーβの実験場だけはあるわ
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: 「ヨークタウン」は、アンチエックスが世界αを離れた後に手に入れた技術かもしれないって推測してるわ
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: もし機会があれば、私たちも「黒き太陽」施設内で直接見てみたいものね
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: ――もちろん問題ないが、一つ相談が
――この実験場では現地勢力の戦力が貧弱で、戦線も長く伸びすぎている。支援としてコンパイラーを投入できないだろうか？
検討したことはあるけれど、結論は無理ね
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: 本当はそっちの座標に異常が現れた直後に支援に向かいたかったわ！
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: でも、こうやって通信できてるとはいえ、あなたが現在いる実験場の正確な位置をこっちから特定できてないの
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: もしかしたら、ハイエロファントが何か偽装してるのかもしれないわね……
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: とにかく、私たちには……ええと、解析しようにも時間がかかるわ
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: （「塔」の権限を失った今、支援を送ることも難しいのか……）
――わかった。こちらの戦況はまだ大丈夫だろう
わかったわ！
scripts.factiontag: コンパイルフィールド

scripts.say: 二日後、「エルベ」が援軍を連れて現れたため、浄化が完了した防衛線を彼女に引き継いだ。
その後、自分たちはブランデンブルクを目指した。
ランス市――
ケルン市――
マインツ市――
マクデブルク市――
ブランデンブルク――
マインツ市に到着すると、豪華な出迎えがあった。
あなたたちの名前を耳にしていましたが、ようやくお会いできましたね。ようこそ帝国へ
私は帝国の摂政にして選挙侯の「ケルン」です。神聖総連帝国を代表して、あなたたちが帝国にもたらしてくれた援助に心から感謝します。
同じ「ケルン」といっても、豪華な出迎えの礼装をまとっている彼女は記憶の中の姿とは似て非なる雰囲気に感じた。
――よろしく。ブランデンブルクまで行かないと会えないと思ってたよ
そうなのですか？私はむしろケルン市まで直接出迎えに行こうと考えていました
あなたたちの到来は私に関係しており、また私たちの希望も背負っているのですから、こちらから出向くのが筋というものです
――「レーゲンスブルク」から一番事情を知ってるのは「ケルン」と聞いた
――ここに来るまでに出会った人は皆こちらの存在に驚いていたが、「ケルン」は一番落ち着いてたよ
――色々とこちらの疑問に答えてくれれば助かる
そうですね。立ち話もなんですし、一度大聖堂に戻りましょうか
それと、落ち着いていたとおっしゃいましたが、私にも意外に感じたことくらいありますよ
あなたたちの名前を知った時、マインツこそが私の召喚した「登臨者」だと思っていました
今となっては、彼女は単に巻き込まれたに過ぎないのかもしれませんね
真の重要人物はきっと{playername}、あなたでしょう
――ん？それはどういう？
――自分以外にも、戦える者たちだっているが…？
その他の方々は艦船ですから、戦えて当然です
ですが、あなたは違います
艦船を召喚する儀式で一緒に召喚された「一般人」…それは本当にただの「一般人」でしょうか？
大聖堂ではすでに儀式の準備を整えてあります
聖印盟約書によれば、選挙侯の位は順位継承以外に、「選挙侯認証儀式」というもう一つの方法があるそうです
儀式の認証を経れば、艦船でも選挙侯になることができ、そして七人以上据えてもいいようです
もちろん、この儀式を行う前提条件は法聖降臨の儀式と同じで、必ず「登臨者」の協力が必要なのです
まずは、この検証から始めるのはどうでしょうか？
これで……いいのか？
大聖堂の中、マインツは「ケルン」が用意した大量の燭台の中に立っていた。
はい。そこに立って心で感じてみてください
……具体的に何を「感じる」べきなんだ？
この場所、あなたの名前の由来、それに込められた意味、そしてそれが背負う期待を感じてください
神の名において、あなたが何かを得んことを
「ケルン」は最後の準備を終えると、こちらへと歩いてきた。
――自分は何をすれば？
聖印盟約書には「登臨者」が行うべき具体的な事項は記録されていません
あなたは儀式の場に立っているだけでよいかと
――ただここに立っているだけでいいのか……？
周りを見渡し、大聖堂を注意深く観察してみた。
ここの時代に合わせた内装が施されているが、この「大聖堂」はどうやら、何らかの巨大な機械装置の外殻のようだ。
（おそらくこれもハイエロファントが残した施設だろう……）
（安全性に問題はないよな……？）
「ケルン」はその場から去り、大聖堂には自分とマインツだけが残された。
証明が点灯すると共に、大聖堂内にどこからともなく斉唱の声が響き渡った。
その声の影響を受けたからか、マインツは深い眠りに落ちていった。
光が虚空より現れ、世界を満たした――
――歴史上において、完成したことのない船については、当然一般大衆の集団認識の中に固有のイメージが形成されることはありません
そのような存在を、メンタルキューブを通じて誕生させるためには――
まずその設計図を完成させ、実際に建造できるほどの詳細な資料を準備する必要があります
その後――その概念にイメージを固定化させます
同型艦が実際に建造されている場合は話が早いです。実在する同型艦を利用し、そのイメージの境界を定めることができますから
しかし、もし同型艦すら存在したことがないのでしたら、少し面倒です
その場合、最も良い着眼点はその「名前」です
名前とその原型を関連付けることで、認知、伝播可能な具体的なイメージの生成を試みることができますから
これらが現在、私たちの間で一致している見解……で間違いありませんよね？
そうね。でもまあ、あることを考えていてね。もし名前とイメージがある期間の間、互いに独立して存在できるのであれば――
先に一つのイメージを想像して、それから名前と概念的に結び付けさせ、メンタルキューブを通じて誕生させる……
そういったことも、実現できると思わない……？
フリードリヒ、その力……
驚くことはないわ。特別計画艦としてより一歩進んだだけよ
scripts.actorName: フリードリヒ・デア・グローセ

scripts.say: この場所、あなたの名前の由来、それに込められた意味、そしてそれが背負う期待を感じてください
神の名において、あなたが何かを得んことを
――今の光景は……アンジュとソフィアが、計画艦が誕生するための理論を話していた………？
――名前がなければ、名前を結びつける……意味がなければ、意味を与える……
――名前が背負う意味……その方向でもう一歩進める……
――そういうことだったのか……これがこの儀式の本質だ！
――これが計画艦プロジェクトの本質……！
これなら、選挙侯認証の儀式は成功し、マインツも更なる力を得られる。
誰かがすでに法聖の「概念」と唯一の「答え」を結びつけているため、法聖召喚の儀式もまた成功するはずだ。
その答えとは、度重なる「概念」のひも付けを通じて、自らの力を蓄えている存在……
――マルコ・ポーロの出番だ！
マインツの儀式を終え、ブランデンブルクではなく、アヴィニョン市へ向かって法聖降臨の儀式を行うことにした。
ローマに次ぐ法聖を象徴しうるこの都市があるそうだ。
――前にもこんなことをやっていたような……
マインツ市――
ストラスブール市――
法聖降臨の儀式の実施規模は大きく、複数の都市の聖堂との連携のため、調整が多く必要となる。
そんな中、ゲッツたちからジェノヴァ市内で「深潜」を行いたいと相談を受けた。敵の侵攻を正確に捉えるための調査を行いたいそうだ。
ふぅ……黒き領域を調査することは正しいことだと信じていますわ
帝国の防壁を弱体化させてまで行う調査、その価値を証明してみせますわ
敵の侵攻の察知は私たちにまかせて、そっちは必ず儀式を完成させて！
順調にいきますように……
――くれぐれも気をつけて、連絡は適宜保ってくれ
気をつけるよ……
ストラスブール市――
アヴィニョン――
道中何事もなく――
アヴィニョン市に到着すると、「ケルン」はすぐに儀式の準備に取り掛かった。
すでに時間は遅くなっていて、ゲッツたちの準備を確認する必要があるため、儀式は翌日の正午に行うことになった。
だが、クレマンソーはずっと何か考え込んでいる様子だった。
夕食後、彼女から書斎で話したいと誘われた。
――……一時的に別行動を取りたい？
しばらく考えてたんだけど
ほら、儀式の後マルコ・ポーロにたっぷり働いてもらうんでしょ？
もし私が関わっていると知ったら、あの子のやる気に深刻な影響が出ると思わない？……それに私たちはこの実験場について知らないことが多すぎる
ここのアイリスはほとんどが黒き領域に飲み込まれ、審判廷も散り散りになってしまってるって話でしょ……？
だから私はそのあたりの仕事を引き継ぎ、審判廷を再編したいの
――でもクレマンソーの最優先の狙いはそれじゃないんだろう？
――教国聖都にある資料が気になって仕方がない、だから一刻も早く調査に行きたい……そうだろ？
ふふ、やっぱり指揮官にはすべてお見通しなのね
ええ、指揮官の言う通りよ
――……自信があるのか？
絶対的な自信があるわ
――アルジェリーとガリソニエールを連れて行くといい。こっちの防衛戦力は十分にある、心配いらない
ではお言葉に甘えて……ううん、お心遣いに感謝するわ～
また後で会いましょ。すべて順調にいきますように――
